# PhotonicChipletInterconnect

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A high-bandwidth, low-latency interconnect scheme using silicon photonics to link chiplets within a TCC architecture. Enables scalable, energy-efficient data movement between chiplets, overcoming electrical interconnect bottlenecks in topology-centric computing.
